description: This file contains utility functions for configuration management in the Cuttlefish project, including functions to parse instance strings, retrieve environment variables, generate paths, and check system capabilities.

methods.name: InstanceFromString
methods.description: Parses an instance string, removing known prefixes and converting to an integer ID, defaulting if invalid.

methods.name: InstanceFromEnvironment
methods.description: Retrieves the instance ID from environment variables, with fallback logic.

methods.name: GetDefaultVsockCid
methods.description: Calculates the default VSOCK CID based on the instance ID.

methods.name: GetVsockServerPort
methods.description: Calculates the VSOCK server port based on a base port and guest CID.

methods.name: GetGlobalConfigFileLink
methods.description: Returns the path to the global configuration JSON file.

methods.name: ForCurrentInstance
methods.description: Generates a string identifier for the current instance with a prefix.

methods.name: RandomSerialNumber
methods.description: Generates a random serial number string with a given prefix.

methods.name: DefaultHostArtifactsPath
methods.description: Constructs a path within the host artifacts directory.

methods.name: HostBinaryDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path for host binaries.

methods.name: UseQemuPrebuilt
methods.description: Determines whether to use prebuilt QEMU binaries based on target product.

methods.name: DefaultQemuBinaryDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path for QEMU binaries, depending on whether prebuilt is used.

methods.name: HostBinaryPath
methods.description: Returns the full path to a specified host binary.

methods.name: HostUsrSharePath
methods.description: Returns the path to shared resources for a binary.

methods.name: HostQemuBiosPath
methods.description: Returns the path to QEMU BIOS files.

methods.name: DefaultGuestImagePath
methods.description: Returns the path to guest images.

methods.name: HostSupportsQemuCli
methods.description: Checks if the host supports QEMU CLI capabilities.
